subagents.comment: Fallback to next non-Gemini model when primary is unavailable.

orchestrator_review.flow: Whenever a subagent completes a task, the Orchestrator (running on Gemini) acts as the critical reviewer. The Orchestrator runs compilation checks, executes the Vitest test suites, validates file structures, and provides direct feedback to the subagent. The subagent must address the orchestrator's feedback iteratively until both agree and all verification steps pass.
